_why: The first live run: twelve diagnostic answers from corpus.v2.json, chosen to show whether the real marker separates what it should before credits are spent on all 31. Run with `npm run testmode-bots:golden` (live). Read the marks and the feedback together, not the numbers alone. Version 2 swaps the open-question keyword list (sa11a-keywords) for the closed question's shotgun list (cl11a-shotgun), so the golden run still imports the phrase-matched paper.
